pap: The CIS program will provide students with the essential soft skills, business knowledge, and technical expertise needed to excel as a business computing professional. The program focuses on developing skills in written and verbal communication, leadership, teamwork, business acumen, computer programming, web development, database design, data analysis, management, and IT management.
paq: The Computer Science places an emphasis on scientific computing and problem-solving. Students are encouraged to develop their skills in programming, enabling them to effectively instruct computers and increase productivity. Through their studies, students learn techniques to enhance the performance of hardware devices, such as computers and robots, allowing them to complete tasks that were previously unattainable. These techniques may involve new methods of data representation, data transfer, data compression, encryption, and more.

The Pre-Veterinary Medicine Program at Murray State University has the ability to fulfill the prerequisite requirements for all thirty-two veterinary schools across the nation. Kentucky has established agreements with Auburn University for thirty-eight students and Tuskegee University for four students. These spots are reserved for legal Kentucky residents based on a competitive selection process.

Murray State University’s Pre-Veterinary Medicine program is a four-year undergraduate program that focuses on educating students in the care of various animals including dogs, cats, laboratory animals, horses, beef, sheep, swine, and exotics. The curriculum is specifically designed for students who are aiming to gain acceptance into a veterinary school.
59b: The Veterinary Technology program at Murray State University is a four-year baccalaureate program. Students enrolled in the Veterinary Technology program receive instruction in the health care of dogs, cats, laboratory animals, horses, beef, sheep, swine, and exotics. Additionally, students participate in a semester of intensive instruction at a veterinary diagnostic laboratory, focusing on diagnostic and research techniques in both large and small animals.
7uf: The Master of Science in Information Systems (MSIS) degree program is designed as a pragmatic, problem-solving oriented program that combines modern information technology practices with business practices. It examines the critical issues surrounding IT decision-making, the technological aspect of the solution, and the human aspect of the solution.

Program Description

We are glad you are here. Welcome to the AACSB Accredited MBA Program in the Arthur J. Bauernfeind College of Business at Murray State University in Kentucky, USA. Our MBA Program has a long, rigorous and proud tradition of quality and excellence in business and management education, and a recognized capacity for meeting the educational needs and challenges of MBA students in the 21st Century. Although the quality of our MBA Program is self-evident, external validations of this quality abound. For instance, we have held continuous accreditation by AACSB-International—The Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business, since 1981, making ours one of the longest accredited MBA programs in the world. AACSB-International is the premier Management Education accrediting agency in the world, widely regarded as the “gold standard” for the prestige of any business program
